description: Source code for shader utility functions, including shader compilation, program linking, and shader source code snippets for different shader versions and types within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: ReadEntireFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string buffer.

methods.name: CompileProgramInternal
methods.description: Compiles vertex, geometry, and fragment shaders, attaches them to a program, and links it.

methods.name: CompileShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of a given type from source code.

methods.name: CompileShaderFromFile
methods.description: Reads shader source from a file and compiles it.

methods.name: CheckLinkStatusAndReturnProgram
methods.description: Checks if a program linked successfully; deletes and returns 0 if failed.

methods.name: CompileProgram
methods.description: Compiles a shader program from vertex and fragment source strings.

methods.name: CompileProgramWithTransformFeedback
methods.description: Compiles a program with transform feedback varyings.

methods.name: CompileProgramWithGS
methods.description: Compiles a program with geometry shader source.

methods.name: CompileProgramFromFiles
methods.description: Reads vertex and fragment shader files and compiles the program.

methods.name: LoadBinaryProgramOES
methods.description: Loads a binary program using OES extension.

methods.name: LoadBinaryProgramES3
methods.description: Loads a binary program for ES3.

methods.name: LinkAttachedProgram
methods.description: Links a program and returns success status.
